I accidentally discovered the benefits of speeding up media while watching them back in 2010 or 2011 and have started regularly watching things at that pace (but without audio pitch correction), but only if it's media I've seen before. Why? Well, firstly, watching without the audio pitch correction makes things even funnier than simply watching at an accelerated pace. Secondly, I only watch at a sped-up pace after seeing something once already because then I can just pay attention to new things that I've never noticed before. I find that if I'm watching something at an increased pace the first time I actually tend to miss things because it's a bit too much to handle all at once.
